reason: $199 on a ten lakh move is about 1.25% and my bank charges a few hundred rupees for the remittance, so I'd do the paperwork myself or with my own CA. I also can't see the real exchange rate until the confirm screen, so I can't compare it to the paisa.
objection: The flat fee is far above what my bank charges, and 'partner bank's published rate' hides the FX margin, which is the number I actually compare. I'd have to run the whole thing against my bank and a CA I already know first.
would_change_my_mind: A total all-in cost (fee plus FX margin) clearly under what my bank and my own CA cost, shown as a live quote before I sign up, and a fee closer to CAD $60-80 for ten lakh.
